sentence: This project builds algorithms that automatically design a microfluidic chip together with the software that controls it.
This project develops computational tools that simulate how microscopic particles, such as bacteria, move through a fluid.
This project studies how beneficial bacteria colonize plants and keep pathogens out of an existing microbial community.
This project studies how DNA in mitochondria is repaired and how recombination happens, using budding yeast.
This project uses atoms and microwave fields to build a system that simulates how complex properties of materials emerge.
This project builds statistical methods that remove unwanted technical variation from single cell data and analyze cell type composition.
This project reconstructs long-term histories of hurricanes, wildfires and harmful algal blooms to study how they interact and affect ecosystems.
This project builds a network that removes bottlenecks in moving and sharing research data between distributed sites.
This project tries to prove that quantum computers can do some tasks better than classical computers, and that randomness does not save space.
This project designs chip hardware and scheduling software so that deep neural networks in autonomous vehicles meet strict timing requirements.
This project studies how an ultracold gas of polar molecules flows and how atoms and molecules collide.
This project uses 3D printing to build flexible pressure sensors that stay sensitive across a wide range of pressure.
This project builds a shared platform that brings together tools, datasets and evaluation methods for testing biometric systems.
This project builds a thin flexible implant that uses ultrasound to stimulate and record activity across the whole brain.
This project uses machine learning and data science to try to predict how quickly polar ice sheets will shrink.
This project tests which material properties help coral cells attach and grow faster.
